chapter: Marriage and the end of the shows
title: Danville, Virginia: Boisse DeLegge and the Huberts
summary: Returning to the TOBA story, he tells how Joe Hubert was lured away from Boisse DeLegge's show and punched in the eye.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: We left off...I think, you know, we'd been talking about a lot of things so we got away from the chronology, but we didn't talk about...I guess you went to Chicago, that was one place where you spent some time...

Yeah...well, I spent almost a year in Chicago. What had happened was, when I left the TOBA after the conclusion of that ill-fated tour, we went to Atlanta and...well, I've yet to tell you how I got my first wife, you know...we ll pick up there.

We left Memphis and went to Virginia. I'm not saying that that's the manner in which it was done or whether that's the time, but . We went to Danville, Virginia, and we had this show and a man by the name of Boisse DeLegge had , came into town at the same time we were there. So people used to just try to steal...not steal...but entice people from one show to the other. So the show that we were on needed three more people to go...well, four people...to go into Danville, Virginia. So we...there was a guy named Herbert Hubert, the guy that wrote "I'm Falling for You," and his wife and the two dancers--he had a singing group and dancing group. So we met at this restaurant and we were talking and, you know, people didn't get any money...you didn't get any money...they just didn't pay you 'cause they didn't have it. If they didn't
have it they didn't give it to you. So we asked Joe Hubert to come and join our show and leave Boisse DeLegge and come with Happy Donovan and Travis Tucker. He said all right, he'd do it.

Well, somehow Boisse DeLegge found out that Joe was going to leave the show. So Joe was trying to hide around to keep him from catching up with him. So finally he caught up with Joe and Boise was, you know, from New Orleans, and with a hot temper, and so he belted Joe one right in the eye. Well, Joe was ready to stay with the show, you know but naturally ...people agitating, he said, 'Well, you haven't paid me for the last eight weeks,' and that was the only way he could get away from the show, because the guy knew he hadn't paid him. So that's how he got away from the show.
